intermediate.name: Alto de la Malahá
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Alto de la Malahá (125.4 km)

story: During this stage, an early breakaway finally formed after several attempts. With 70 kilometers to go, Ivan Romeo and Andreas Leknessund bridged across, later dropping Josh Burnett. Romeo attacked inside the final two kilometers, winning the stage and taking the overall lead.
